# The Claude Code Power Pack

> Eight Agent Skills (plain SKILL.md markdown procedures) for people who use Claude Code or another coding agent
> that reads the Agent Skills format. One-time purchase, $29 USD, single-seat license, free updates. A free starter
> kit of four skills is also available. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic.

## What is in the paid pack (8 skills)
- adversarial-self-critique: get a real judgment on an idea, plan or the agent's own work instead of agreement.
- review-ai-code: a 9-step ordered review and a pre-merge checklist for AI-written code.
- self-verifying-loops: build an unattended agent loop that checks its own work and stops or escalates.
- context-curation: choose the smallest sufficient context per step so long sessions stay sharp.
- claude-md-rules: write a CLAUDE.md the agent actually follows.
- multi-agent-finisher: make a multi-agent system converge (builder and judge are separate roles; bounded revision).
- agent-bash-security: lock down the shell so a long autonomous run cannot do something irreversible.
- skill-authoring: turn a repeating workflow into a durable Agent Skill.

## Field notes (free, no signup)
Short write-ups of specific failures, each one checked against Anthropic's own documentation or observed
directly. They are the reasoning behind the skills, published in full.
- Your skill stops working in long sessions: Skill bodies are truncated after compaction, and truncation keeps the start of the file. https://tools.prepbrix.com/skill-stops-working-long-session
- A CLAUDE.md rule that worked and then stopped: Path-scoped rules do not survive compaction. The project-root file does. https://tools.prepbrix.com/claude-md-rule-stopped-applying
- Your scheduled task says it succeeded and did nothing: A run that produces no output is not missing, not stuck and not failed. The fourth check. https://tools.prepbrix.com/scheduled-task-ran-but-did-nothing
- Your cron job fired on the wrong day: Day-of-month and day-of-week are OR-ed, plus dispatch offsets and catch-up runs. https://tools.prepbrix.com/cron-fired-on-the-wrong-day
- Your agent stalled and you lost the work: You probably did not. Flush per item, then finish from the file. https://tools.prepbrix.com/agent-stalled-lost-the-work
- Why Claude ignores your CLAUDE.md: Four reasons a rule does not hold, a scope-gap test, and a drift canary. https://tools.prepbrix.com/claude-md-ignored
- Your agent agrees with everything you say: Why a coding agent validates a bad plan, and how to get a real judgment instead. https://tools.prepbrix.com/agent-agrees-with-everything
- Auto mode: what actually changed: The permission mode that now starts by default, and which of your allow rules it drops. https://tools.prepbrix.com/auto-mode-what-changed

## Free starter kit
- Four skills: review-ai-code, claude-md-rules and context-curation (samples from the paid pack) and
  session-handoff-memory (free kit only, not in the paid pack), plus a one-page cheatsheet.
- Download (Gumroad, $0): https://resilience88.gumroad.com/l/ngwuyp

## Install
Copy a skill folder into ~/.claude/skills/ (all projects) or a repository's .claude/skills/ (one project), then invoke
it by name or let the agent load it when a request matches.

## Pages
- Landing page: https://tools.prepbrix.com/
- Why your agent agrees with everything: https://tools.prepbrix.com/agent-agrees-with-everything -- agreement is a
  trained preference, not a quirk; why self-critique in the same session fails; withhold your stance, separate maker
  from judge, put a different model family in the judge's seat; per-step checker versus final verifier. From the
  adversarial-self-critique skill.
- Claude Code auto mode, what changed: https://tools.prepbrix.com/auto-mode-what-changed -- auto mode is now the
  starting permission mode on Pro, Max and Team; broad allow rules are dropped on entry while narrow ones survive; a
  subagent's own permission setting is ignored; why deny rules are the only floor; and how to prove a control
  actually blocks. From the agent-bash-security skill.
- Why Claude ignores your CLAUDE.md: https://tools.prepbrix.com/claude-md-ignored -- four reasons a rule in
  CLAUDE.md does not hold (prohibition with no alternative, scope gap, priority label, file no longer in context),
  the scope-gap test, a positive drift canary, and a five-minute audit. Drawn from the claude-md-rules skill.
